meta.title: When Everyone Else Has Gone to Sleep
meta.author: Sigveseb
meta.description: The soundtrack of When Everyone Else Has Gone to Sleep by Sigveseb (2020-07-11). Executable music that placed 2nd in the 16k executable music competition at Solskogen 2020. 120 BPM, 2:12, 22 tracks, 1140 notes. Instruments: 1 Falcon (FM synth), 1 Slaughter (subtractive synth), 7 Adultery (GM.DLS sampler). Effects: 4 Scissor, 11 Leveller, 1 Echo, 13 Smasher, 1 Chamber, 1 Twister. Its Adultery instruments play waves from the Windows GM.DLS bank: they sound as intended only with that bank (GM_DLS=<path to gm.dls>); macOS's own GS bank has other waves. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: the WaveSabre song was read from the running executable's memory (tools/ws-extract, Wine), converted by `synth-convert ws` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64, effects 65-73) and imported with `song import` (lanes cut into 2-, 4- or 8-bar patterns, notes rounded to 960 ticks per beat). Against the bit-exact WaveSabre port it differs by +0.04 dB loudness and at most 0.84 dB in any octave band from 63 Hz to 8 kHz (16 kHz up to 3 dB brighter, a known difference of the unified engine). Track names are derived here from each track's instrument and notes; the executable does not store the authors' names. No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
